column1: # mica-vectors-derivation v1: refused vector, relation, the valid vector it is written against.
#   edit-of     a small edit of that vector: at most two changed lines, and not identical.
#   minimal-of  an independently written minimal lock of the same shape, so no line bound
#               applies -- the sibling names the shape rather than the source text.
# Written because the intent existed only in whoever wrote the fixture, and because pairing
# by smallest diff picks the wrong sibling (measured 2026-09-20).
